<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="kalphite-king-solo-ranged" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Kalphite King — Solo Ranged</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/fb0VtpIAFc.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This guide assumes you are already familiar with the basic mechanics of Kalphite King, which can be found in </nowiki><span><nowiki>#unknown-channel</nowiki></span></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Being on a Kalphite Slayer task </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> for slayer helm </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285340460449792.png?v=1" alt="slayerhelm" title="slayerhelm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and Genocidal </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689503091539705870.png?v=1" alt="genocidal" title="genocidal" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is </nowiki><strong><nowiki>completely optional</nowiki></strong><nowiki>, but will result in slightly faster kills.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This guide assumes no green shields happen, but they are very rare and generally won't ruin kills.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="preset-and-relics"><nowiki>Preset and Relics</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=c6459333-cf59-48bf-a9c3-e5258185a5f8 <nowiki>Ranged</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>​
</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2Fc6459333-cf59-48bf-a9c3-e5258185a5f8.png?alt=media" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Notes</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275453128714.png?v=1" alt="ripperpouch" title="ripperpouch" kind="icon" /><nowiki> set the autofire rate to 1.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643846948570267648.png?v=1" alt="sirenicbody" title="sirenicbody" kind="icon" /><nowiki> switch has </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087864012840.png?v=1" alt="ch4" title="ch4" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to prevent stuns for almost the entire kill.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489341984779.png?v=1" alt="kwuarmsticks" title="kwuarmsticks" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489136463894.png?v=1" alt="spiritsticks" title="spiritsticks" kind="icon" /><nowiki> increase damage to help ensure the rotation ends consistently at 13.2-14.4 seconds.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Toss the </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1" alt="vulnbomb" title="vulnbomb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> 1-2 ticks before clicking on Kalphite King, otherwise Melee phase might null your click.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>

</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006119102814887957.png?v=1" alt="perfectequilibrium" title="perfectequilibrium" kind="icon" /><nowiki> stacks)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>In the fight:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>r</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1" alt="grico" title="grico" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1" alt="gloomfirebow" title="gloomfirebow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → ‎ ‎</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061860371828929.png?v=1" alt="deadshot" title="deadshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1" alt="sgb" title="sgb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1" alt="gloomfirebow" title="gloomfirebow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1" alt="escape" title="escape" kind="icon" /><nowiki> 2t later) → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1" alt="snapshot" title="snapshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1" alt="snapshot" title="snapshot" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>If you don't kill after the last </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1" alt="snapshot" title="snapshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, finish with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1" alt="deathsporearrows" title="deathsporearrows" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1" alt="piercingshot" title="piercingshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and improvise.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>If you get Melee phase spawn, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1" alt="adrenrenewal" title="adrenrenewal" kind="icon" /><nowiki> after </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1" alt="sgb" title="sgb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1" alt="gloomfirebow" title="gloomfirebow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> over the first </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1" alt="snapshot" title="snapshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is an option to help ensure a 13.2 second kill, but not necessary.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Post-fight building:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>Target kalphite marauder + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1" alt="deathsporearrows" title="deathsporearrows" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1" alt="piercingshot" title="piercingshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1" alt="deathsporearrows" title="deathsporearrows" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1" alt="grico" title="grico" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1" alt="deathsporearrows" title="deathsporearrows" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1" alt="piercingshot" title="piercingshot" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>These </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1" alt="deathsporearrows" title="deathsporearrows" kind="icon" /><nowiki> ensure you can both skip gaining adrenaline at crystal for </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1" alt="gdeathsswift" title="gdeathsswift" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and avoid the </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1" alt="adrenrenewal" title="adrenrenewal" kind="icon" /><nowiki> during the pre-build, saving both banking time and supplies. The harder </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1" alt="dummy" title="dummy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> build also makes it harder to gain adrenaline from </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1" alt="grico" title="grico" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if you get a slower kill if you time </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061866193518744.png?v=1" alt="imbueshadows" title="imbueshadows" kind="icon" /><nowiki> wrong.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
